title: The 3 Best Sous Vide Machines Under $150
h1: The 3 Best Sous Vide Machines Under $150
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for sous vide machines under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at sous vide machines under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Anova Precision Cooker Nano 3.0, 800W
products.blurb: Key specs: 800W heating element, Typically $100 to $130, 8L/min flow rate.
strengths: Full WiFi app control and Anova's established reliability record at a price well under the flagship
8L/min flow rate matches the significantly pricier Precision Cooker 3.0
Highest rating (4.6) of any circulator in this price band
limitations: 800W recovers more slowly than 1100W competitors on large or cold batches
Compact clamp range limits very large container use

products.name: KitchenBoss Sous Vide Cooker G321, 1100W
products.blurb: Key specs: 1100W brushless DC motor, Typically $75 to $90, Built-in TFT display with preset recipes.
strengths: Built-in display removes any app dependency
Quiet brushless motor performs well over long batch cooks
limitations: Smaller brand with less long-term reliability history than Anova
Fewer total ratings than the more established competitors
features: Built-in TFT display with preset recipes

products.name: Instant Pot Accu Slim Sous Vide Immersion Circulator, 800W
products.blurb: Key specs: 800W heating element, Typically $70 to $80, Onboard touchscreen, no app required.
strengths: Leaves the most budget headroom of any pick in this price band
Fully functional without an app or WiFi setup
limitations: No WiFi or smart features at any price
Fewer premium touches than the Anova Nano's app ecosystem
features: Clamps to 6 or 8-quart Instant Pot inner pot or any stockpot

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
